changelog:
[+] Rooms Page.
Here you can join one of the available rooms or create your own. You can also send an SOS signal or go to the recent SOS signals page.
All rooms, except the 'main-room', disappear after 5 minutes of inactivity (when no one has posted there). All users share their rooms with others (but without message history).
[+] SOS Mode and Recent SOS Page.
On the Rooms page, you can enable SOS mode by clicking the bottom left button. While in SOS mode, your geolocation is sent to nearby users every 30 seconds. Users will also receive a notification about a new SOS signal on their devices, and on the Recent SOS page, they can see your coordinates, speed, and current movement. They can also navigate to your location by following the arrow pointing to your geolocation.
When SOS mode is disabled, users will no longer receive new signals, and the old signal will be deleted after 5 minutes.
[+] Notifications.
Standard notifications for new messages in rooms, as well as new SOS signals.
